title: A1, A2, B1, B2, C1 ne C2 kyerɛ dɛn?
invitation: Wubehu saa level code yi wɔ nhoma, adesua, sɔhwɛ, app ne kasa profile mu wɔ wiase nyinaa. Ha yi kyerɛ nea ɛkyerɛ ankasa, nea enti wo tumi betumi ayɛ soronko wɔ kasa mu nimdeɛ ahorow mu, ne sɛnea Gef de di dwuma.
summary: Gef de CEFR A1–C2 yɛ kasa tumi ho map a obiara betumi de adi dwuma, ɛde Pre-A1 ma anammɔn a edi kan, na ɛde Nea ɔka kasa no yiye koraa / Native-level ka C2 akyi wɔ ne selector no mu. Wo tumi ankasa betumi ayɛ soronko wɔ akenkan, tie, kasa, kyerɛw, nkɔmmɔdi ne mediation mu.

blocks.title: Kasa tumi ho map a wɔbom de di dwuma
blocks.text: A1 kosi C2 fi Common European Framework of Reference for Languages, anaa CEFR. Ɛma asuafo, akyerɛkyerɛfo, sukuu, sɔhwɛ ne nhoma tintimfo nya ɔkwan baako a wɔde kasa fa kasa tumi ho, fi mfitiase nkitahodi kosi kasa a ɛyɛ ahofadi, flexible na ɛyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ. A ne B nyɛ sukuu grade, na Gef nnya adwene sɛ kasa nyinaa wɔ vocabulary ne grammar kwan koro.

blocks.title: Pre-A1 · Anammɔn a edi kan
blocks.text: Pre-A1 yɛ baabi a ɛwɔ A1 anim. Ebia wuhu nsɛmfua, nsɛnkyerɛnne, nnyigyei, din, nɔma anaa nsɛm kakraa bi a woakyere agu tirim, nanso woda so hia mmoa pii. CEFR nneɛma foforo de Pre-A1 ka ho. Wɔ Gef self-rating slider no mu, mfinimfini kyerɛ nimdeɛ biara nni hɔ na ring a edi kan no yɛ A1.

blocks.title: A1 · Beginner
blocks.text: Wɔ A1 mu wubetumi de kasa kakraa bi ayɛ nneɛma a ɛho hia wɔ nsɛm a wunim ne tebea a ɛyɛ mmerɛw mu. Wubetumi ate nsɛm tiaa ase na woakyɛ nsɛm a ɛho hia. Kɔ A2 kyerɛ sɛ wobɛtwe wo ho afi nsɛm a woakyere agu tirim ho na woatumi adi dwuma wɔ da biara tebea pii mu.

blocks.title: A2 · Da biara kasa
blocks.text: Wɔ A2 mu, da biara asetena fi ase yɛ mmerɛw wɔ kasa no mu: nnipa, mmeae, dwumadi, adwuma anaa sukuu, adetɔ, akwantu, bere ne ahiade ntɛm ara. Kɔ B1 kyerɛ sɛ wobɛka adwene abom wɔ nsɛm tenten mu, akyerɛ ntease mmerɛw na woatumi adi tebea a wonnim ansa ho dwuma.

blocks.title: B1 · Ahofadi
blocks.text: Wɔ B1 mu wubetumi adi da biara tebea pii dwuma a wonyɛ sentence biara nhyehyɛe ansa. Wubetumi ate asɛm titiriw wɔ kasa a emu da hɔ na ɛware mu na woaka osuahu, nhyehyɛe, nea wopɛ, adwene ne ɔhaw ho asɛm. Kɔ B2 hia range, detail, ahoɔhare ne control pii.

blocks.title: B2 · Ahofadi a emu yɛ den
blocks.text: Wɔ B2 mu wubetumi akɔ nkɔmmɔ tenten mu yie, akasa fa adwene a ɛyɛ concrete ne abstract ho, na woayɛ adwuma wɔ social, academic ne professional tebea pii mu. Kɔ C1 hia inference, nuance, register, nhyehyɛe ne style so control a ɛyɛ fɛfɛɛfɛ.

blocks.title: C1 · Advanced
blocks.text: Wɔ C1 mu kasa no bɛyɛ adwinnade a wode di dwuma flexible. Wubetumi adi nsɛm a emu yɛ den dwuma, ate nea wɔanka no tẽẽ ase, na woasesa tone ne style ma tebea no. Kɔ C2 fa depth, nsonsonoe nketewa, reformulation ntɛm, specialist areas ne control pɛpɛɛpɛ ho sen grammar mmara a etwa to.

blocks.title: C2 · Nimdeɛ a ɛkorɔn paa
blocks.text: C2 yɛ CEFR reference level a ɛkorɔn paa. C2 user betumi adi kasa a emu yɛ den paa dwuma a ɔwɔ meaning, structure, implication ne style so control pa. C2 nkyerɛ sɛ wunim asɛmfua biara, wonyɛ mfomso da, anaa woabɛyɛ native speaker.

blocks.title: Kasa no yiye koraa / Native-level · Gef ankasa top self-description
blocks.text: Gef de level baako ka C2 akyi wɔ ne self-rating mu: Kasa no yiye koraa / Native-level. Ɛnyɛ CEFR C3 na ɛnyɛ official certification. Obi a ɔnyɛ native speaker nso betumi apaw no sɛ ne tumi wɔ skill no mu te sɛ ɔpanyin native speaker a ɔka kasa no yiye koraa. Gef reka tumi ho asɛm, ɛnyɛ abusua anaa baabi a wufi.

blocks.title: Wo kasa tumi yɛ shape, ɛnyɛ letter baako
blocks.text: Skill asia betumi ayɛ soronko: Akenkan, Tie, Kasa, Kyerɛw, Interaction ne Mediation. Ebia wokenkan wɔ C1, wutie wɔ B2, na wokasa wɔ A2. Radar graph a ɛwɔ axis asia ma saa nsonsonoe yi da adi.

blocks.title: Level nyɛ lesson biara a atwam checklist
blocks.text: Kasa sua nyin wɔ akwan a ɛnyɛ pɛ. Wubetumi agyae grammar mfitiase baako na woanya tumi a ɛkorɔn wɔ baabi foforo. Gef de level kyerɛ nea wubetumi ayɛ nyinaa, ɛnyɛ sɛ B2 kyerɛ sɛ A1 ne A2 lesson biara awie pɛpɛɛpɛ.

blocks.title: Gef seesei susu akenkan, ɛnyɛ wo hexagon nyinaa
blocks.text: Gef yɛ reading-first app seesei. Wubetumi akyerɛ wo ara rating wɔ skill asia no nyinaa, nanso evidence a efi nhoma, reading lesson, comprehension ne dictionary use mu ɛsɛ sɛ ɛka Reading estimate nkutoo. Gef nnsusuw Kasa, Tie, Kyerɛw, Interaction anaa Mediation fi akenkan activity mu.

blocks.title: A2 nhoma label no ka nhoma no ho asɛm
blocks.text: Sɛ Gef frɛ nhoma bi A2 a, ɛyɛ reading difficulty signal. Sɛ wuwie nhoma no a ɛma evidence fa akenkan ho, nanso ɛnkyerɛ sɛ skill foforo no nyinaa nso yɛ A2. Sɔhwɛ nso saa ara: hwɛ nea wɔsusuwii ankasa.

blocks.title: Mediation yɛ dɛn?
blocks.text: Mediation yɛ sɛ woboa ntease ma ɛtwa gap bi. Ɛka translation ne live interpreting ho, ne sɛ wobɛka text a emu yɛ den tiawa, akyerɛ adwene wɔ kasa mmerɛw mu, de nsɛm akɔ nnipa a wonni kasa koro mu, anaa woasesa akyinnyegye mu nsɛm ama afa abien ate ase.

blocks.title: Course progress betumi ama hint a mfaso wɔ so
blocks.text: App binom kyerɛ sɛnea wɔn course ne CEFR di nsɛ. Wɔ Duolingo Score mu 0–29 yɛ A1, 30–59 A2, 60–99 B1, 100–129 B2, na 130–160 fa C1/C2 ho wɔ published course scale no mu. Eyi yɛ course progress, ɛnyɛ independent proof sɛ skill biara wɔ level koro; enti Gef de score no sie sɛ evidence baako.

blocks.title: Wiase wɔ kasa level system pii
blocks.text: CEFR nkutoo nni hɔ. ACTFL wɔ U.S. kasa nkyerɛkyerɛ mu, ILR 0–5 wɔ U.S. government contexts bi mu, CLB/NCLC wɔ Canada, JLPT N5–N1 ma Japanese, ne HSK ma Mandarin. Wɔwɔ botae soronko, enti Gef mfa label biara nkyerɛ sɛ ɛwɔ perfect one-to-one equivalent.

blocks.title: Nhwɛso: Japanese JLPT
blocks.text: Efi December 2025 no, JLPT result a woadi mu nkonim betumi akyerɛ official CEFR reference level sɛnea JLPT level ne total score te. Nanso JLPT susuw language knowledge, reading ne listening; ɛnnsusuw speaking, writing anaa interaction. Enti mapping no ka skill a wɔsusuwii no nkutoo.

blocks.title: Chinese HSK resesa, enti version no ho hia
blocks.text: HSK yɛ standardized Mandarin test. HSK 2.0 wɔ level asia ne historical CEFR relation. HSK 3.0 foforo no wɔ stages abiɛsa ne levels akron, nanso 2026 rollout no da so wɔ transition mu. Gef sie HSK version na ɛfrɛ nine-level-to-CEFR conversion estimate kosi sɛ official concordance bɛba.

blocks.title: Framework nyɛ test no ara
blocks.text: CEFR yɛ framework a ɛkyerɛ proficiency. Tests ne organizations betumi de wɔn result ahyɛ ho. Score bi hia context fa skill a wɔsusuwii, sɛnea ne bere a alignment no yɛe, ne sɛ result no yɛ official anaa estimate. Gef estimate ɛnsɛ sɛ wɔda no adi sɛ official CEFR certificate.

blocks.title: Universal A2 word count baako nni hɔ
blocks.text: Vocabulary ho hia, nanso CEFR mfa word count baako nkyerɛ A1, A2 anaa B1. Kasa ahorow wɔ word segmentation, script, compounds, morphology ne meaning nhyehyɛe soronko. Enti English vocabulary estimate ntumi nkɔ kasa nyinaa mu tẽẽ.

blocks.title: Sɛnea Gef de levels di dwuma
blocks.text: Gef de CEFR A1–C2 yɛ shared coordinates, Pre-A1 ma mfitiase anammɔn, na ɛde ne ankasa Kasa no yiye koraa / Native-level ka soro. Nhoma wɔ reading difficulty na profile betumi akora skill asia values. Language-specific curriculum data kyerɛ concepts, word meanings, grammar, scripts ne text types wɔ ne ho.

blocks.title: Gefstimate yɛ estimate, ɛnyɛ diploma
blocks.text: Daakye sɛ Gef ka evidence pii bom a, English UI betumi afrɛ estimate no Gefstimate. Wɔrenhyɛ pun no wɔ kasa nyinaa mu. Ɛyɛ evidence-based estimate ma skill pɔtee bi, ɛnyɛ official CEFR certificate, na Gef ɛsɛ sɛ etumi kyerɛ evidence a wɔde yɛe.

blocks.title: Wobɛkɔ level a edi hɔ no sɛn?
blocks.text: Ɛnyɛ progress bar baako a wubɛhyɛ ma. Daakye Gef estimates betumi aka lesson performance, material difficulty a wokenkan yie, mmoa dodow a wuhia, comprehension results ne evidence foforo a ɛfa skill no ho abom. Vocabulary ne grammar boa, nanso ɛnyɛ gate baako. Nhoma mmerɛw baako nnsɛ sɛ ɛma wo level kɔ soro ntɛm, na da den baako nso nnsɛ sɛ ɛma wo level sian.

blocks.title: Tiawa mu
blocks.description: Zero kyerɛ sɛ nimdeɛ biara nni hɔ. Pre-A1 yɛ anammɔn a edi kan. A1 ne A2 si da biara tumi mfitiase. B1 ne B2 kyerɛ ahofadi a ɛrenyin. C1 ne C2 kyerɛ advanced, flexible na precise proficiency. Gef de Kasa no yiye koraa / Native-level ka soro. Wo tumi ankasa yɛ skill asia no shape.
